items.docs: Generates a tax form for account holders operating in the US. For more information, refer to [Providing tax forms](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces-and-platforms/classic/tax-forms).

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the account holder.

params.name: formType
params.description: The type of tax form you want to retrieve. Accepted values are **US1099k** and **US1099nec**

params.name: year
params.description: The tax year in YYYY format for the tax form you want to retrieve

items.docs: Generates a tax form for account holders operating in the US. For more information, refer to [Providing tax forms](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces-and-platforms/us-tax-forms/).
